issue.title: bob plugins sync from a dirty checkout skips the inclusion proof and refuses with a false 'no single commit holds the bundle' reason
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-os.10 note #2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); the bob-cli-os land agent traced the root cause in code on master 2f4fef6d.

Root cause: in `src/native/plugins/deploy.rs` `evaluate_guard`, the `PriorStamp::Complete { matches_vault: true }` arm for a dirty stamp from another checkout or host runs `find_inclusion_proof` only `if incoming_clean`. When the incoming bob-plugins worktree is dirty, the proof never runs, and the guard falls through to a refusal whose reason reads "no single commit reachable from HEAD holds the stamped bundle byte for byte". That reason can be false. In the reported case a landed ancestor (f703f1c) held all three deployed assets byte for byte, and the same HEAD found the proof right after `git stash`.

Fix direction (worker decides; check bob-cli-fy / bob-cli-h8.2 for why the clean-incoming gate exists):
- either run the proof regardless of incoming cleanliness, since it is about the vault's current bytes being landed, not about the incoming tree;
- or keep the gate, but when a proof exists, refuse with the real reason ("the incoming checkout is dirty; commit or stash, then rerun").

Keep refusing when no reachable commit holds the whole stamped bundle. Add unit coverage next to the existing dirty-stamp inclusion-proof tests for a dirty incoming checkout. Align bob-plugins `docs/develop/deployment.md` if the rule changes.

task_type_fields.impact: Agents deploying from a working tree that has unrelated edits get a false refusal that sends them looking for a missing commit, or reaching for --force. It slowed the bob-cli-os rollout.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. Deploy a plugin into the vault from checkout A with uncommitted changes (the stamp records dirty), then land the same bytes on bob-plugins master.
2. In checkout B, whose HEAD contains that landed commit, make any unrelated uncommitted edit.
3. `bob plugins sync -r <checkout B> -p <plugin> --dry-run` refuses with "no single commit reachable from HEAD holds the stamped bundle byte for byte".
4. `git stash` in checkout B and rerun: the sync permits with a proving commit.

Seen by bob-cli-os.10 on apollo, 2026-11-22, for bob-ledger-tools (proving commit f703f1c).

payload.entry: deploy-inclusion-proof: chose to run find_inclusion_proof regardless of incoming cleanliness (removed incoming_clean gate on dirty-stamp arm). Rationale: the proof is about the vault's current bytes having landed, not about the incoming tree; when the stamped bundle sits in history, overwriting cannot erase unlanded work, so a dirty incoming checkout with unrelated edits may proceed (its own bytes get a fresh dirty stamp). This removes the false 'no single commit reachable from HEAD' refusal instead of merely rewording it, while the refusal stays exactly true when no proving commit exists (bob-cli-mv case untouched). Kept the incoming_clean gate on the new clean-stamp proof arm. Verify: cargo test --lib -- native::plugins 65/65 pass (incl new dirty_stamp_with_dirty_incoming_permits_via_proof and dirty_stamp_with_dirty_incoming_and_no_proof_refuses); cargo test --test cli plugins:: 36/36 pass; docs_reference passes; just docs-check 449 passed. Remaining just-check reds are pre-existing at HEAD in untouched prose files (clippy bool_then/format lints, lib every_value_arg_has_a_decision, cli root_help prose snapshot), all owned by epic bob-cli-qj.5.1. Live dry-run from linked bob-plugins checkout exit 0 with no refusals; no real sync (docs-only change there per bob-plugins AGENTS.md).
